question: After a leakage-safe rolling reconstruction of Frozen V3.1.1 + Stage6 B + importance_low2, is there stable proper-loss residual in within-1X2 score geometry rather than in 1-1 marginal mass?

evidence_basis.r43d0: Direct historical-frequency score reallocation improved the 1-1 top-pick collapse statistic but materially worsened validation/test exact-score logloss; do not hand-edit 1-1.
evidence_basis.r43d0a: Mean P(1-1) was near or below empirical 1-1 frequency while 1-1 was the argmax score in roughly 61%-64% of matches with small top1 margins; treat the defect as mode geometry, not a global 1-1 mass penalty.
evidence_basis.old_global_dependence: Global beta-binomial, negative-binomial overdispersion and rolling bivariate dependence were unstable or non-improving; do not revive them as global parameters.

data_roles.state_history: 2014-2022 completed Big5 only for strictly-prior PIT state construction

base.importance_low2_method: Refit only on prior seasons inside each rolling fold using the already-frozen importance_low2 specification: offset logistic for <=2 goals on importance_diff + importance_mean, ridge 0.01, max abs log tilt 0.35, then within-1X2-region low-score exponential tilt.

heads.draw_11: Conditional on draw region, 1-1 versus all other draw cells.
heads.home_margin1: Conditional on home-win region, one-goal home-win margin versus margin >=2.
heads.away_margin1: Conditional on away-win region, one-goal away-win margin versus margin >=2.

candidate_definition.draw_geometry: Apply only the fitted draw_11 structural head.
candidate_definition.winner_margin_geometry: Apply home_margin1 and away_margin1 structural heads.
candidate_definition.combined_geometry: Apply draw_11, home_margin1 and away_margin1 heads sequentially.

classification.robust_material: Exact-score logloss improves in both 2021 and 2022, mean rolling exact-score delta <= -0.00075, exact 1X2 preservation holds, and max score-cell change <=0.03.
classification.robust_small: Exact-score logloss improves in both rolling years and structural safety holds, but mean rolling exact-score delta is between -0.00075 and 0.
classification.mixed_or_rejected: Any rolling year has positive exact-score logloss delta or a structural safety bound fails.
classification.important_note: This is a consumed-history screen only. No candidate is promoted or formally enabled by this workflow.
